# Analysis of the environmental conflict generated by the hydropower plant “Hydrocucucan” in Roncesvalles, Tolima

Since the end of the 20th century, environmental issues have gained prominence in global agendas, although they are often addressed in a fragmented manner, without considering their political, economic and social impacts. This research focuses on the conflict generated by the hydropower to water edge "Hydrocucuana" in Roncesvalles, Tolima, which affected not only its immediate area, but also neighbouring municipalities, particularly the indigenous community of Playa Rica. After more than a decade of negotiations, still unresolved points persist, which has generated stagnation in the process. Using a transdisciplinary approach, this study characterizes the conflict and breaks it down to understand it from secondary sources. Subsequently, it analyses it with a methodology based on the analysis of the discourse and the grouping of categories offering a methodological proposal that integrates various analytical techniques to provide a more complete understanding of environmental conflicts and their social representations . thats to provide a more comprehensive understanding of environmental conflicts and their social representations
